description: This Java class 'IfMatchPreconditionHeader' implements the 'PreconditionHeader' interface for handling 'If-Match' HTTP headers in the context of conditional requests. It encapsulates logic to match entity tags as specified by RFC 7232, providing methods to generate header key-value pairs, check if certain entity tags meet the precondition, and extract such headers from a collection of headers.

classes.name: IfMatchPreconditionHeader
classes.description: Immutable class representing an 'If-Match' precondition header, used for handling entity tag based preconditions in HTTP requests.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the HTTP header key for 'If-Match'.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the entity tags to match.

methods.name: meetsConditionFor
methods.description: Checks if a given entity tag satisfies the 'If-Match' condition based on strong match criteria.

methods.name: fromDittoHeaders
methods.description: Static method to extract an 'IfMatchPreconditionHeader' instance from a collection of Ditto headers, if present.
